export_evidence: ImportKey India customs records, page header: "Total Shipments 114 Records detected / Trading Partners 5 / Ports 17 / Latest Cargo 2026-02-13". Exact row quoted: "2026-02-13 | GAYATRI PSYLLIUM INDUSTRIES | TO THE ORDER | PSYLLIUM HUSK 98% MESH 100- | AHEMDABAD ICD INSBI6, India | Tanjung Priok, Indonesia | 12119032 | 9660203". Further rows seen: 2026-01-29 AHEMDABAD ICD INSBI6 -> Bangkok, Thailand, HS 12119032, BOL 9174068; 2026-01-28 AHEMDABAD ICD INSBI6 -> Bangkok, Thailand, HS 12119032, BOL 9120178; 2026-01-13 AHEMDABAD AIR ACC INAMD4 -> BANGKOK, THAILAND, HS 12119032, BOL 8735154; 2025-12-29 AHEMDABAD ICD -> Bangkok Modern Termi, THAILAND, HS 12119032, BOL 8308677. Source counter: page claims 114 total shipments; 5 individual dated rows actually visible on the free view. Top ports listed: MUNDRA SEA 7, AHEMDABAD ICD 6, Bangkok 5, AHEMDABAD ICD INSBI6 3, Jebel Ali 2. Registered address shown: "70, KHADIA GANJ BAZAR" (Ahmedabad, Gujarat).
note: Export side is factually confirmed: five dated outbound customs rows with bill-of-lading numbers, all psyllium husk under HS 12119032, shipped from Ahmedabad ICD/air to Indonesia and Thailand between 2025-12-29 and 2026-02-13. Declared HS 121190 is the 6-digit parent of the actual 8-digit 12119032, so the declared code is consistent and no correction is needed. Domestic supply evidence could not be established: GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender participation and annual-report splits are not public for this entity and were not found; search engines returned unusable results (Google 429, DuckDuckGo timeout, Bing irrelevant) and Volza returned 403. Domestic status therefore recorded as unknown, not as none_found, because absence of a public record here is not proof of absence of domestic supply. Revenue and export volume figures are null: ImportKey free view exposes shipment counts and dates but no values or weights, and no other public source was reachable. No CIN or PAN was found in any source read, so both remain null rather than inferred. Note that the ImportKey buyer-side table on the same page lists unrelated large corporates (Bajaj Auto, TVS Motor, Apar Industries) under generic 'TO ORDER' consignee labels; those rows belong to other companies and were not attributed to this supplier.
